method: Hold-to-resolution walk-forward multi-trader consensus. Win iff curPrice>=0.99 (token paid $1), loss iff curPrice<=0.01. Play = conditionId+side. Trader Q/lane/median use only markets with endDate <= this market endDate minus 1 day. Voters need 20 prior resolved markets and ≥$200 stake. Category doNotTail filters applied in 'filtered' strategies. $100/play. VWAP = their price; join_max = worse member entry; slips +1/2/5c.

bugfix.previous_error: First backtest treated realizedPnl>0 as a binary win and paid 1/price-1. Scalps on losing tokens were scored as huge underdog wins.
